purpose: Define the shareable knowledge-base system package boundary.
notes: The portable default is the three system Skills plus routing, contracts, tools and tests.
Account Skills, their registry, production memory, local paths, secrets, runtime state and knowledge assets are user data and must not be included.
A new computer binds the global Skill with skill-install, then creates an empty user layer with user-init.
The portable system package is licensed under Apache-2.0; knowledge, account, user, raw, runtime and archive content remain outside that license as defined in LICENSE_SCOPE.md.
